description_short.value: Ghanaian non-life insurer, 40% owned by the Government of Ghana, with an investment advisory and asset management subsidiary.
description_short.source: Written by us from the SIC Insurance PLC consolidated and separate financial statements for 2025 (GSE PR 247/2026, report of the directors: principal activities) and the 2023 Annual Report (GSE PR 399/2024, shareholder information)

description_full.value: SIC Insurance PLC underwrites non-life (general) insurance in Ghana. Its subsidiary, SIC Financial Services Limited, provides investment advisory, asset and fund management, financial consultancy and brokerage services. The Government of Ghana owns 40% of the company and the Social Security and National Insurance Trust (SSNIT) 11.82%, and the government appoints most of the board. It has been listed on the Ghana Stock Exchange since 25 January 2008, and its head office is Nyemitei House on Ring Road East, Osu, Accra. Insurance revenue reached GHS 598 million in 2025. The board and management changed in 2025, when Bernard Ahiafor became chairman and James Agyenim-Boateng managing director. The auditor qualified its opinion on the 2025 accounts because SIC Financial Services may have understated its liabilities from lawsuits: it had provided GHS 21 million for a court judgment that its lawyers put at about GHS 95.7 million, and nothing for a 2024 judgment in favour of Bank of Africa of about GHS 68 million including interest.
